label: illustrative; validate locally
climate_source: NASA POWER cached historical daily climate; uniform illustrative shifts
grid_source: design choice, not empirical; validate locally
distance_rule: Euclidean distance in grid steps from 0 C and 0% rainfall; ties prefer smaller temperature change, then smaller absolute rainfall change
tie_rule: Use one fixed-seed permutation of exact feasible rotations to choose among exactly equal objective scores; baseline wins an exact tie with the best feasible rotation
seed_source: design choice, not empirical; validate locally

tipping_point.sentence: No top-strategy change occurs within the tested temperature and rainfall grid.

The top strategy first changes at +3 °C and +0% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from pigeonpea then fallow (repeated annually) to soybean then fallow (repeated annually).

The top strategy first changes at +1 °C and +10% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from pigeonpea then maize (repeated annually) to soybean then maize (repeated annually).

The top strategy first changes at +3 °C and +10% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from pigeonpea then fallow (repeated annually) to soybean then fallow (repeated annually).

caveat: Uniform shifts to cached historical daily weather are a sensitivity stress test, not a climate projection. Crop calendars and soil storage stay fixed. Crop and irrigation inputs are illustrative; validate locally.
